root_text:
MPOX, Marburg, Ebola,HMPV don’t worry me much personally. 
I can mitigate those infection risks for me, my family, and my community.

A Novel BirdFlu virus worries me A LOT (H5,H1,H7, others). 
H5N1 in particular seems to be heading our way

nodes.author: Article99UNchar
nodes.text: @richardhirschs1 @RickABright @kakape I asked Microsoft Co-Pilot to assess the probability that Avian influenza becomes a global pandemic over the following time frames and this was the response: https://t.co/YPfsijZ331

nodes.author: RickABright
nodes.text: @Article99UNchar @richardhirschs1 @kakape Interesting guess. Can you share rationale provided for guesses, or did it only produce a random table?  Each is a concerning underestimate, given limited surveillance, data transparency, or development for rapid dx, and effective preventatives or treatments. A lot of prep needed

nodes.author: Article99UNchar
nodes.text:
@RickABright @richardhirschs1 @kakape These are some the data points that were used to support the estimate.

Harvard Medical School’s MassCPR consortium describes H5N1 as an “existential threat” due to its rapid mutation and increasing host range, including mammals like cattle, seals, and even polar bears.

nodes.author: Article99UNchar
nodes.text: @RickABright @richardhirschs1 @kakape University of Padua virologists note that H5N1 clade 2.3.4.4b has infected over 199 mammalian species, a sign of growing adaptability to non-avian hosts.

nodes.author: Article99UNchar
nodes.text:
@RickABright @richardhirschs1 @kakape https://t.co/PDDA8K2h5Z highlights that while human-to-human transmission remains rare, the virus’s ability to infect mammals raises serious concerns about its evolutionary trajectory.

What would you say is the probability that bird flu will become a global pandemic w/n 5 years?
